title: HalluPrism: When Multimodal Uncertainty Should Diagnose, Not Decide
abstract: arXiv:2608.29193v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can assign similar confidence to answers that fail for different reasons. We propose HalluPrism, a behavioral diagnostic that re-runs an answer after visual degradation, blank-image replacement, and grounding or relation checks. These targeted probes yield a signature over visual-perturbation sensitivity (V ), image-removal confidence retention (L), and grounding/relation-probe instability (A). Across 58K+ examples from four benchmarks and four MLLMs, image-removal confidence retention is most prevalent, while grounding/relation-probe instability better separates failure families. Only 18 of 48 source-target checks are diagonally aligned, so the coordinates should be interpreted jointly rather than as independent causal sources. With the dataset fixed, the joint signature improves failure-family AUROC from 0.634 to 0.769 on HallusionBench and from 0.707 to 0.817 on VizWiz, with smaller gains on PO

translated_title: HalluPrism：当多模态不确定性应当用于诊断而非决策时
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）可能会对因不同原因而失败的答案赋予相似的置信度。我们提出了 HalluPrism，这是一种行为诊断方法，它在视觉退化、空白图像替换以及接地（grounding）或关系检查之后重新运行答案。这些针对性的探针产生了一个涵盖视觉扰动敏感性（V）、图像移除置信度保留（L）以及接地/关系探针不稳定性（A）的特征签名。在来自四个基准和四个 MLLM 的 58K+ 样本上，图像移除置信度保留最为普遍，而接地/关系探针不稳定性则能更好地区分不同的失败类型家族。48 个源-目标检查中仅有 18 个呈对角对齐，因此这些坐标应当被联合解读，而不能视为相互独立的因果来源。在固定数据集的情况下，该联合特征签名将 HallusionBench 上的失败家族 AUROC 从 0.634 提升至 0.769，在 VizWiz 上从 0.707 提升至 0.817，在 PO（POPE）上的提升相对较小。
tldr: HalluPrism 提出一种行为诊断方法，通过对答案施加视觉退化、空白图像替换和接地/关系探针来生成失败特征签名，其联合解读可显著提升多模态大模型失败类型识别的 AUROC，表明多模态不确定性应用于诊断失败原因而非直接做决策。
en_tdlr: HalluPrism is a behavioral diagnostic that probes MLLM answers via visual degradation, blank-image replacement, and grounding/relation checks, and jointly interpreting the resulting uncertainty signature substantially improves failure-family AUROC, showing that multimodal uncertainty should be used to diagnose, not decide.
